# ReShiki 0.16.0

This release keeps drawings in your GitHub repositories with a Compare that
knows chemistry, adds a Settings page, puts name and property captions under
molecules, and brings NMR prediction and shift labels to Python, the command
line and agents.

- **Drawings on GitHub:** sign in from the GitHub button in the status bar,
  open drawings and other chemistry files with **Open from GitHub…**, and
  **Send** every changed drawing as one commit with an SVG preview. A drawing
  changed on GitHub meanwhile is never overwritten.
- **Compare that knows chemistry:** **History** and the **changed on GitHub**
  dialog tell chemical edits from moves, flips and rescaling, and name each
  change with the drawing's atom numbers, such as **OH added at C4**.
- **Captions under molecules:** **Show properties** puts the name, formula,
  Mol. Wt. and other properties under a molecule and keeps them current. Type
  your own name, such as `Compound 3a`.
- **NMR from scripts:** Python, `reshiki --cli` and the MCP tools predict ¹H or
  ¹³C shifts and write them beside the atoms, as journals print them. Designed
  by @ssiddhantsharma.
- **Settings page:** **Cmd+,** (**Ctrl+,**) opens every preference on one page.
  Copies and exports get their own background and PNG resolution; copies
  default to 300 dpi.
- **Clean up at once:** Clean up applies as one Undo step, keeps the drawing's
  size and stands rings upright. Large rings such as 18-crown-6 stay round.
- **Files as themselves:** ChemDraw and MOL files open and save as themselves,
  SD files open, and ChemDraw diagrams with several molecules keep their
  arrangement.
- **Faster large drawings:** selecting, aligning, redrawing and panning large
  drawings take a fraction of the time.

**Breaking for developers:** MCP tools return one result shape
(`operation_api` 2), and the headless JavaScript library moves to
`@ameyanagi/reshiki-headless`.

**File compatibility:** most drawings saved by 0.16.0 still use document
version 30 and open in 0.13.1, 0.14.0 and 0.15.0. A drawing with a property
caption (38) or a name line or typed name in it (39) needs 0.16.0, and older
versions ask you to update. On macOS and Linux the data folder moves to
`~/.reshiki/`, which older versions do not read.

macOS release downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads
remain unsigned; Windows production signing is pending.
